title: Random Trio #16 (스테인드글라스+금박+보태니컬)

#3 (Botanical): THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 20s goddess, wide hip narrow physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — hips so impossibly wide extending beyond frame creating the most extreme hip-to-waist ratio ever, waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, upper body slim emphasizing the dramatic hip explosion, hair threaded through with real trailing vines — full body living sakura growing directly from her own skin covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not a printed pattern, not a dress, every stem rooted directly into her living skin and every petal standing up in true three-dimensional relief casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours. Pattern density maximum on all 3, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 aspect ratio.
